concept: Midnight refectory with ceremonial tray and chapel echo
creativeDirection: A theatrical mixed-media diorama photographed like a handcrafted stage set, combining collage, painted surfaces, and graphic emblem forms.
scene: A long refectory-like hall seen from a slightly low frontal viewpoint, as if looking toward a small raised platform at the far end beneath a high wall symbol.

elements.element: the central lone singer appears once on the platform, holding a microphone at chest height, with shoulder-length wavy hair and a cream floral-patterned jacket
aged folded cassette-insert paper becomes the cracked runner covering the long table, with visible creases, worn edges, and dense typewriter-like texture worked into the surface
the hall borrows the church interior feeling with stone arches, scattered chairs, a microphone stand, and a glowing cross-like wall light high in the distance
a vivid paint-burst erupts across the tabletop near the foreground like spilled ceremonial pigment, with orange, pink, blue, and yellow droplets radiating outward
one large white goat stands in the foreground beside the table, with a few smaller brown and black goats clustered farther back as curious witnesses
a bold circular eagle seal is transformed into a floor medallion in black, white, and red at the center aisle
a dark-sleeved hand enters prominently from the side presenting a silver tray holding a miniature Earth, flowers, a white dove, butterfly, and tiny golden sun face
a large black five-pointed star appears as a stark cutout banner or window shape above the distant platform, with five small star marks subtly aligned below it

coverSummaries.description: A close-up stage photograph of a single male performer with shoulder-length wavy hair, holding a microphone at chest height. He wears a light-coloured patterned jacket with floral or vine-like detailing. The figure is centered against a dark concert background with pink and purple lighting haze and a soft magenta border glow around the square image.
coverSummaries.medium: stage photograph with graphic text overlay

coverSummaries.album: Give Out But Dont Give Up The Original Memphis Recordings
coverSummaries.description: A photographed cassette inlay or folded paper insert placed on a black background. The off-white paper has worn edges, a horizontal fold across the lower third, and dense typed track-list formatting. One section is upside down at the bottom, reinforcing the physical folded-paper look.

coverSummaries.album: So Here We Are Best Of Doves
coverSummaries.description: A wide interior photograph of three musicians seated in a large church-like space with stone columns and arches. Two hold guitars, and a drum kit cymbal is visible in the foreground. A microphone stand sits near the center, with benches and chairs scattered in the background. A glowing cross hangs high on a large pale wall at the back.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: glowing cross above musicians in a church interior

coverSummaries.description: An abstract cover filled with splattered and pooled paint-like colour over a black background, with repeated large lettering layered across the image. The central form resembles a bright orange and pink burst or liquid bloom, surrounded by blue, yellow, green, and red accents and speckled droplets.
coverSummaries.medium: abstract mixed-media artwork with graphic overlay

coverSummaries.description: A vintage colour photograph of five young men standing closely together in an outdoor petting-zoo setting, surrounded by several goats. One large white goat dominates the foreground, while brown and black goats cluster around the group. Trees and fencing appear in the background, and a green banner spans the top portion of the cover.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: band members feeding and handling goats

coverSummaries.description: A stark black background with a large circular seal in white. Inside the seal is an eagle with spread wings holding a branch in one claw and a baseball bat in the other, with stars circling around it. The composition is bold and emblematic, with an additional red stamped-style line of text across the lower portion.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: eagle crest inside a circular seal

coverSummaries.description: A surreal collage-like image of a hand in a dark suit sleeve holding up a silver serving tray against a starry black space background. On the tray sit the Earth, bright flowers including sunflowers and daisies, a white dove in flight, a butterfly, and a small golden sun face peeking from the side.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: hand presenting a tray topped with Earth and flowers

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist graphic cover with a large solid black five-pointed star centered on a plain white background. Beneath it is a row of five much smaller black star-related shapes spaced horizontally.

prompt: A midnight refectory-chapel interior seen from a slightly low frontal viewpoint down a long central table toward a small raised platform at the far end; the primary subject is a lone male singer on the platform, centered and depicted only once, with shoulder-length wavy hair, holding a microphone at chest height and wearing a light cream jacket with floral vine-like patterning. A dark-sleeved hand enters prominently from one side in the foreground presenting a silver serving tray topped with a miniature Earth, sunflowers and daisies, a white dove in flight, a butterfly, and a tiny golden sun face; below it, a large white goat dominates the foreground near the table edge while a few smaller brown and black goats linger farther back. The hall has the atmosphere of a church-like stone interior with arches, scattered chairs, a cymbal glimpse, a spare microphone stand, and a glowing cross-like wall light high on the pale back wall; above the platform, a stark large black five-pointed star appears as a cutout banner or window, with five small star marks aligned beneath it. The long tabletop is covered with an off-white folded cassette-insert sheet transformed into a runner, showing worn edges, horizontal creases, and dense typed formatting as surface texture; near the front, a multicolored liquid paint-burst spills across the runner in orange, pink, blue, and yellow with speckles and droplets. In the floor at the center aisle, integrate a bold circular eagle crest medallion in black and white with a red stamped accent. Mixed-media handcrafted diorama, paper collage, painted plaster, cut graphic shapes, miniature props, photographed like a theatrical stage set. Strong central perspective, clear hierarchy with tray and singer leading, goats and paint-burst as supporting accents, deep black negative space in upper reaches, dramatic spotlighting with magenta-purple concert haze around the singer and softer amber light grazing the table and animals. Palette of black, off-white, cream, stone grey, magenta, purple, orange, pink, sunflower yellow, deep green, and red; surreal, ceremonial, intimate, nocturnal mood. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
